title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The 'Protection et moyens de Subsistances (Protection and Livelihoods)' project in the territories of Beni (from 2026), Masisi and Lubero in the Democratic Republic of Congo, implemented by Oxfam through ICSP will directly reach 24,000 people working within 8 communities (from 2026) most affected by armed conflicts qualified in the 2022 OCHA humanitarian response plan. Oxfam will work with partners Solidarité pour la Promotion Sociale et la Paix (SOPROP) and Fédération des Producteurs Agricoles du Congo (FOPAC-North Kivu) to deliver strategy that aims to contribute to peace, stability, poverty reduction and the protection of civilians through interventions aimed at strengthening the capacities of communities to overcome the crises and challenges arising from them. This programme outcome focuses on building capacity of smallholder farmers on climate smart agriculture, soil and natural resource conservation, organic manure making and application, cultivation of drought tolerant crops, irrigation, mechanisation, postharvest management to reduce harvest losses and use of renewable energy in food production and value chains. This is a critical intervention under this impact area of the programme and would have not been funded if this intervention was not implemented.
